title: Scrub the recognizable big bunny until bubbles hide his form
problem: The incoming group appears at a cut and contact is uneven. The new owner-directed reveal requires all four helpers visibly working on the same old dust-bunny shell.
beats: The big lavender dust bunny retains his own spiral ears, forehead curl, face and pearls while all four helpers begin scrubbing; obvious wet soap lather appears at every tool contact.
Everyone keeps scrubbing as white pale-blue suds and translucent bubbles spread from those contact patches over his body and ears.
His recognizable outline becomes lost under a billowing blanket of soap bubbles; the little rainbow bunny remains completely hidden.
end_state: All four helpers scrub the big bunny under a body-obscuring blanket of soap bubbles; no part of the little rainbow bunny is visible.
